title: Sugar makes children hyper.
description:
Sugar makes children hyper. Medical News Today traces the idea to theories from 1947 and the 1970s, neither of which is now backed by the data.

A 1995 JAMA review pooled 23 blinded, placebo controlled studies from 16 reports. Sugar did not affect behaviour or cognitive performance.

A small effect was not ruled out. The authors wrote that a small effect, or effects on subsets of children, could not be ruled out.

Parents were the variable. In a 1994 study, 35 boys aged 5 to 7 all received aspartame. Mothers told it was sugar rated their sons as significantly more hyperactive.

They also behaved differently. Those mothers maintained more physical closeness, and showed trends to criticise and talk to their sons, according to Medical News Today.

ADHD is a separate question. Medical News Today says the jury is still out for children with ADHD.

The sugar was not the variable.

Sources:
- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7474248/: abstract only. Established JAMA, November 1995, 274(20):1617 to 1621, that sixteen reports met the criteria for a total of 23 within-subject studies, the conclusion that sugar does not affect behaviour or cognitive performance of children, that a small effect or effects on subsets of children cannot be ruled out, and effect sizes from minus 0.14 to plus 0.30 across 14 constructs.
- https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/amp/articles/medical-myths-does-sugar-make-children-hyperactive: read in full (Tim Newman, 21 July 2020, fact checked by Hilary Guite). Established the 35 boys aged 5 to 7 whose mothers called them sugar sensitive, that all received aspartame as a placebo, that mothers told it was sugar rated them as significantly more hyperactive, the NEJM 1994 diet study results, and that the jury is still out for children with ADHD.
- https://www.livescience.com/55754-does-sugar-make-kids-hyper.html: read, last 9,500 characters as a model summary only. Corroborated the 35 boys aged 5 to 7 and Mark Wolraich's comment that the placebo effect can be very powerful.
